notes: C-003 consumes governed Phase 19 structured traces and governed split lineage only.
Reusable lesson candidates require TRAIN-only cases, observed evidence refs, and at least two independent split groups.
Any observable contradictory case rejects the reusable candidate; support count cannot average contradictions away.
MODEL_SELF_REPORT is rejected as evidence origin; a model may propose a lesson but cannot certify it reusable.
Generalization remains bounded to observed task-family coverage and is never labeled universal.
C-003 grants no runtime, training, automatic memory-commit, promotion, or automatic roadmap-mutation authority.
Validation and held-out assignments remain evaluation-only and are rejected by the distiller.
The historical C-005/C-006 shorthand identity conflict remains unresolved and is not silently remapped.
Ruff and strict mypy must pass on the user Windows environment before commit or push.
